result.explanation: The customer paid, the payment provider told us, but the client-side confirm call never happened — consistent with the confirm button being unreachable after payment. [orders:ord_0902] [server_logs:2026-10-15T20:00:31Z@/api/payments/webhook]
result.customer_reply: Thank you for your patience. I can confirm your payment went through on our provider's side. Our system did not complete your order after that — that is our fault, not yours. I will release your credits as soon as this is fixed on our side, and you will get a confirmation email.
result.fix_action: Confirm the order server-side from the PAID webhook and grant credits (requires approval). Code fix: never rely on a client click after a PAID webhook.

claims.sentence: The payment provider recorded a PAID charge of 9900 KRW for order ord_0902 [payments:pay_0902] and our server logged the PSP webhook PAID [server_logs:2026-10-15T20:00:31Z@/api/payments/webhook], but the order record stayed pending because no /confirm request was processed [orders:ord_0902].
Hence the customer was charged but the order never confirmed.
